about: Pitt Meadows is a city in Metro Vancouver’s Fraser Valley, at the confluence of the Pitt and Fraser rivers east of Port Coquitlam. Dykeland farms, suburban neighbourhoods, and mountain views toward Golden Ears shape a compact riverside municipality on Highway 7. About 19,000 people live in Pitt Meadows.
